GitHub - Forceflow/cuda_voxelizer: CUDA Voxelizer to convert polygon ...
These are the voxelization timings for the Stanford Bunny Model (1,55 MB, 70k triangles). This is the voxelization time for a non-solid voxelization. No I/O - from disk or to GPU - is included in this timing. CPU voxelization time is heavily dependent on how many cores your CPU has - OpenMP allocates 1 thread per core.
